import json
obs={2:9,12:2,15:4,17:9,18:7,20:6,21:6}
period=next(p for p in range(1,23) if all(all(v==w for j,w in obs.items() if j%p==r) for r,v in [(i,obs[i]) for i in obs]))
print(period, {r: next(v for i,v in obs.items() if i%period==r) for r in range(period)})
pat=[next(v for i,v in obs.items() if i%period==r) for r in range(period)]
grid=[[pat[i%period]]*22 for i in range(22)]
assert len(grid)==22 and all(len(x)==22 for x in grid)
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':grid},separators=(',',':')))
